newsitem.title: UK: Gilts and BTPs lag slightly,T-note/Bund gap widens.
newsitem.headline: Gilts and BTPs lag slightly,T-note/Bund gap widens.

text.p: 1601 GMT - Gilts lag Bunds slightly by one basis point from earlier as gap widens to 184, but still outperform Bunds on the day. BTP/Bund gap edges out one basis point to 169. Italian bonds buoyed by increasing hopes for Italian interest rate cut and supported by lira strength. T-notes lose one basis point to Bunds from earlier as market focus turns to U.S. CPI Tuesday.
Government bond spreads are calculated from Reuter benchmark bond price data and adjusted to take into account interest payment frequency.
